To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the setting time, the compressive strength, the phase evolution, and the microstructure of calcium-phosphate cement are affected by the seeding effect.

(i) the presence of crystalline seeds can accelerate the setting time and improve the mechanical strength, (ii) the seeds also promote the transformation of the initial amorphous calcium phosphate into crystalline apatite, and (iii) the microstructural evolution of the resulting CPC, from a featureless to an elongated plate-like structure, is correlated to its compressive strength.
the seeding effect on calcium phosphate cement is a complex phenomenon that depends on several factors, including the nature of the seed, its size, shape, and surface characteristics.

the influence of crystalline seeds on the setting time and mechanical strength of CPC.
the influence of seeding on the setting kinetics and compressive strength of the CPC.
the synthesis and properties of calcium phosphate cemets, and the influence of seeding effect on the setting time and compressive strength of the resulting cements.
